title: docs(protocol): point the customer-facing "the window-closing condition is tracked separately" sentence at the now-WRITTEN end condition (GA)
body:
Filed by the `domain:devx` execution seat (session `session_01WLJQhde67SeTccsmnBVarV`) at #14043's landing window, per the obligation recorded on that card's claim. ⛔ Unassigned — `pm:*` grading is triage's.

## The gap, one sentence

`content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx:207` (position dated to `origin/main b360cc7d` — re-derive) reads: *"the condition that closes the window is tracked separately and is deliberately not stated here."* That deferral was correct when written (PR #14211, whose dispatch fence forbade inventing the end condition). The end condition is now WRITTEN and maintainer-ruled: PR #14227 recorded it in `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`'s header — **at GA (the fixed group's first general-availability major), the group returns to strict semver**.

## What to do

Replace the "deliberately not stated here" deferral with the ruled one-liner (window closes at GA; strict semver resumes), consistent with the gate-header text — ⛔ no dates, no version numbers, nothing the ruling does not contain. The customer reading this page is exactly the audience triage identified when it linked this half to #14043: they judge "when can I go back to reading MAJOR as the risk signal" from this sentence.

Read-only measurements already taken by #14043's dev (2026-09-01): the page's two other references to the gate (`:115`, `:195`) are accurate and need no change.

## Scope notes for triage

- One file, a one-to-two-line prose edit, `content/docs/protocol/**` (NOT `releases/**`, so no docs-only-PR fence applies).
- Provenance chain: director decision batch B 2026-09-01 「同意」 (the ruling) → #14043 / PR #14227 (the internal record) → this card (the customer-facing half).

## Dedup

#13893 (closed — rewrote both pages but deliberately deferred this sentence) · #14043 (closed — the internal half) · #14210 (open — phantom labels + 2-MINOR dwell on the same page, different defect). No open card covers this sentence.
